what: Drawn props snap to one of −3°, 0° or 3° every .3s (no in-between, steps(1)) — hand-drawn stickers jitter like stop-motion animation. Each prop starts randomly 0~.5s late so several snap off-beat. Piece (data-fx-part=With piece), pieces are split into three groups and folded staggered by .1s (letter-piece title)

options.deg: Tilt angle (deg), default 3 — one of −deg, 0, deg
